The Institute maintains active collaborations with industry and leading academic and research institutions in India and abroad for faculty exchange, joint research, and scholar guidance. DA-IICT houses a Government of India–funded Incubation Center that fosters innovation and entrepreneurship, with additional support from the Government of Gujarat for start-ups. It offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in ICT, data science, information technology, communication design, mathematics and computing, and specialized M.Tech programs conducted jointly with premier institutes in India. Role Description The Research Fellow role at DA-IICT is an on-site position based in Gandhinagar. The Research Fellow will support and conduct research activities aligned with ongoing projects, including literature reviews, data collection, data analysis, and documentation of research findings. Daily responsibilities may include designing experiments or studies, collaborating with faculty and research teams, preparing technical reports, and contributing to research publications and presentations. The role involves assisting in project coordination, maintaining research records and datasets, and contributing to grant proposals or progress reports as required. The Research Fellow is expected to engage actively with the academic and innovation ecosystem at DA-IICT, including seminars, workshops, and interactions with the Incubation Center and partner institutions. Qualifications Strong research skills, including literature review, research design, data collection, and analysis. Solid grounding in information and communication technology, computer science, data science, or a closely related discipline. Ability to use relevant research tools, software, or programming languages (such as Python, R, MATLAB, or similar) for data processing and analysis. Effective collaboration skills, including working with faculty, peers, and interdisciplinary teams in an academic setting. Strong organizational and time-management abilities to handle multiple research tasks and meet project deadlines. Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field; a doctoral degree or enrollment in a doctoral program is an advantage. Prior research experience, demonstrated through theses, publications, conference presentations, or project work, is highly desirable.

review_candidates.title: Planning Engineer
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose The Planning Engineer is responsible for developing, reviewing, monitoring, and maintaining reliable project schedules for EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) projects. The role focuses on Primavera P6 scheduling, progress measurement, critical path analysis, performance reporting, and schedule risk monitoring to support project execution and headquarters-level project controls assurance. Key Responsibilities A. Schedule Development and Management Develop, review, update, and maintain detailed project schedules using Primavera P6. Establish and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), activity coding, baseline schedules, and project calendars. Review contractor and project schedules to validate activity logic, durations, constraints, milestones, critical paths, and project interfaces. Integrate engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and project handover schedules. Ensure schedule integrity, consistency, and compliance with project planning requirements. B. Progress Monitoring and Performance Reporting Monitor and validate planned versus actual project progress. Develop and maintain progress measurement systems, S-curves, milestone tracking, and completion forecasts. Identify critical activities, schedule deviations, delays, and potential impacts on project completion. Prepare weekly and monthly project planning reports, lookahead schedules, executive dashboards, and schedule exception reports. Monitor long-lead procurement activities, equipment delivery milestones, and project interface dependencies. C. Schedule Risk Management and Recovery Planning Identify schedule risks, potential delays, and critical path impacts. Review project recovery schedules and recommend corrective actions to address schedule slippage. Support change impact assessments and Time Impact Analysis (TIA). Maintain schedule update histories, planning assumptions, baseline records, and supporting documentation. Escalate significant schedule deviations and emerging project risks to the Planning Manager. D. Coordination and Stakeholder Management Coordinate with project planning teams to consolidate and validate project schedule information. Work closely with Cost Control teams to support integrated project performance reporting. Liaise with Project Managers, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning, Commercial, Contracts, and Finance teams. Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and package suppliers to obtain accurate schedule updates and progress information. Support the Project Controls Director and senior management with reliable project planning information. Minimum Qualifications and Experience Education - Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, or an equivalent discipline. Professional Experience 6–8 years of relevant experience in project planning, scheduling, and progress reporting. Strong experience in EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) project environments. Proven experience in developing, monitoring, and updating complex project schedules. Experience coordinating engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6. Strong knowledge of Critical Path Method (CPM). Expertise in Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), baseline scheduling, and schedule logic. Experience with progress measurement, S-curves, and project performance reporting. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Working knowledge of Power BI and project dashboards. Knowledge of schedule risk analysis, recovery planning, and Time Impact Analysis. Certifications (Advantageous) Primavera P6 certification. Recognised project planning or project controls certification.

Its practices provide veterinary services within their local communities, combining professional expertise with a commitment to compassionate, responsible animal care. VetPartners values the knowledge and relationships built within individual practices while offering access to wider professional support and shared resources. The organisation aims to create an environment where veterinary professionals can develop their skills, collaborate with colleagues and make a positive contribution to animal health and welfare. About The Role VetPartners is seeking a Veterinary Surgeon to deliver high-quality clinical care and contribute to the day-to-day work of a collaborative practice team. In this role, you will assess patients, discuss treatment options with owners and provide care that reflects current clinical standards and each animal’s individual needs. You will work alongside veterinary nurses, reception colleagues and other professionals, sharing information clearly and treating clients with empathy and respect. The position offers opportunities to build trusted relationships with clients, broaden clinical experience and contribute to a supportive learning culture. The successful candidate will bring sound judgement, a considerate approach and a genuine interest in maintaining high standards of animal welfare. Qualifications Degree in Veterinary Medicine or an equivalent qualification recognised for practising in the United Kingdom. Registration with the Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons, or eligibility to obtain and maintain registration before commencing practice. Knowledge of veterinary medicine, surgery, diagnostic processes and responsible prescribing appropriate to the scope of the role. Ability to assess clinical information, make considered decisions and recognise when further investigation or referral is appropriate. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings, options, risks and costs in accessible language. A compassionate, professional manner when working with animals, clients and colleagues, including in sensitive or challenging situations. Commitment to continuing professional development, reflective practice, patient safety and relevant professional and regulatory standards. Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workload while maintaining accurate, complete clinical records. Responsibilities Conduct consultations and examinations, gather relevant histories, assess patient needs and develop appropriate diagnostic and treatment plans. Provide preventive, medical and surgical care within your competence, following practice protocols and applicable professional guidance. Communicate diagnoses, treatment choices, likely outcomes and follow-up requirements clearly and sensitively to clients. Prescribe and administer medicines responsibly, maintain accurate records and follow requirements for patient confidentiality and data handling. Work collaboratively with veterinary nurses and support colleagues, contributing to coordinated care and a respectful workplace. Monitor patient progress, arrange appropriate follow-up and escalate or refer cases when specialist input is required. Support animal welfare, infection control, health and safety, and the appropriate use and maintenance of clinical equipment. Participate in clinical discussions, case reviews and learning activities, sharing knowledge and contributing to continuous improvement. Help maintain efficient practice operations by managing appointments and clinical priorities thoughtfully and raising concerns through appropriate channels. Benefits VetPartners aims to provide a supportive working environment in which veterinary professionals can develop and contribute meaningfully to their practice. Depending on the employing practice and the terms of the position, the overall package may include a competitive salary, access to continuing professional development, paid professional registration, a pension scheme and staff benefits. Colleagues may also have opportunities to learn from experienced peers, take part in clinical development and access resources available across the wider group. Specific benefits, working arrangements and eligibility will be discussed as part of the employment process and may vary by practice. Equal Opportunity VetPartners is committed to fair and respectful employment practices and welcomes applicants with varied backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Employment decisions are based on role-related skills, qualifications and experience, without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. Reasonable adjustments can be considered to support candidates and colleagues throughout the recruitment process and at work.
